## Overview

Yanapaccha is located near the head of Quebrada LLanganuco, not far from Pisco and Chacraraju. The name Yanapaccha means "black waterfall" in Quechua, although the usual west face route is anything but black. Perhaps the name relates to its appearance from the Portachuela Llanganuco, which would be the opposite face. Brad Johnson, in his book "Classic Climbs of the Cordillera Blanca, Peru," states that "If Pisco were not in the Llanganuco Valley, Yanapaccha would certainly attract all the attention for a good acclimatization peak.
